text:
## Endpoint Security  
### Laptops & Desktops  
**Antivirus/Anti-malware:**
- Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tool deployed
- Real-time scanning enabled
- Virus definitions updated daily
- Suspicious behavior isolated automatically  
**Device Management:**
- Mobile Device Management (MDM) for phones/tablets
- Encryption enforced on all devices
- Lost device remote wipe capability
- OS patches applied within 30 days (critical within 7)  
**Full-Disk Encryption:**
- BitLocker (Windows), FileVault (Mac)
- Encryption keys escrowed (recovery)
- Mandatory for all devices with customer data access

raw_entities.name: Endpoint Security Policy
raw_entities.description: A comprehensive information security policy governing the deployment, configuration, and management of endpoint protection controls across laptops, desktops, and mobile devices. The policy mandates antivirus/anti-malware deployment, device encryption, patch management, and remote wipe capabilities to protect systems and customer data.
context: Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tool deployed
Mandatory for all devices with customer data access

raw_entities.name: Endpoint Detection and Response Tool Deployment
raw_entities.description: Requires deployment of an Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tool across all endpoints with real-time scanning enabled and automatic isolation of suspicious behavior.
context: Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tool deployed

raw_entities.name: Virus Definition Update Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that virus definitions be updated daily to ensure current protection against known malware threats.

raw_entities.name: Device Encryption Enforcement
raw_entities.description: Requires encryption to be enforced on all devices, particularly those with access to customer data. Specifies BitLocker for Windows and FileVault for Mac with mandatory key escrow for recovery purposes.
context: Mandatory for all devices with customer data access

raw_entities.name: Operating System Patch Application Schedule
raw_entities.description: Establishes a tiered patch management schedule requiring standard OS patches to be applied within 30 days and critical patches within 7 days.
context: OS patches applied within 30 days (critical within 7)

raw_entities.name: Mobile Device Management Implementation
raw_entities.description: Requires Mobile Device Management (MDM) to be implemented for all phones and tablets to enable centralized device control and security management.

raw_entities.name: Lost Device Remote Wipe Capability
raw_entities.description: Mandates that all managed devices have the capability to be remotely wiped if lost or stolen to prevent unauthorized access to customer data.

raw_entities.name: Encryption Key Escrow and Recovery
raw_entities.description: Requires that encryption keys be escrowed to enable recovery of encrypted data when necessary, supporting business continuity and authorized access scenarios.

raw_entities.name: Endpoint Detection and Response Tool
raw_entities.description: A security tool deployed across all endpoints to detect, monitor, and respond to suspicious behavior and malware threats in real-time.
context: Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tool deployed

raw_entities.name: Antivirus and Anti-malware Scanning
raw_entities.description: A continuous monitoring control that performs real-time scanning of endpoint activity and maintains current virus definitions updated daily to detect and isolate malicious code.

raw_entities.name: Full-Disk Encryption
raw_entities.description: A mandatory encryption control implemented via BitLocker on Windows devices and FileVault on Mac devices, with encryption keys escrowed for recovery purposes. Required for all devices with access to customer data.
context: Mandatory for all devices with customer data access

raw_entities.name: Mobile Device Management System
raw_entities.description: A centralized management platform for controlling and securing mobile devices (phones and tablets), enabling enforcement of security policies, remote wipe capabilities, and patch management.

raw_entities.name: Operating System Patch Management
raw_entities.description: A systematic control process for applying operating system security patches within defined timeframes: standard patches within 30 days and critical patches within 7 days.
context: OS patches applied within 30 days (critical within 7)

raw_entities.name: Malware and Suspicious Behavior
raw_entities.description: The risk of malware infection and suspicious endpoint behavior that could compromise system integrity and customer data. Addressed through EDR deployment, real-time scanning, and automatic isolation controls.
context: Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tool deployed

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Device Access
raw_entities.description: The risk of unauthorized access to devices and customer data through device loss, theft, or compromise. Mitigated through encryption, MDM, and remote wipe capabilities.
context: Mandatory for all devices with customer data access

raw_entities.name: Unpatched System Vulnerabilities
raw_entities.description: The risk of exploitation of known security vulnerabilities in operating systems and applications. Addressed through a tiered patch management schedule with expedited timelines for critical patches.
context: OS patches applied within 30 days (critical within 7)

raw_entities.name: Data Breach Through Unencrypted Devices
raw_entities.description: The risk of customer data exposure if devices containing such data are not encrypted. Mitigated through mandatory full-disk encryption with key escrow for all devices with customer data access.
context: Mandatory for all devices with customer data access
